source: 691 Pursuer
target: 691 Sectator

source: As the blazing white flames rapidly dissipated, Lumian turned his back on “Hisoka” Twanaku and fixed his gaze on the Guardian, who was swaying unsteadily more than ten meters away.
target: Cum fulgentes albae flammae celeriter evanuerunt, Lumian tergum a “Hisoka” Twanaku vertit et oculos in Custodem, qui plus quam decem metris instabiliter labebatur, fixit.

source: With a chuckle, he declared, “Before, I needed my team’s help to defeat you. But now, I can take you down alone.”
target: Subrisu, dixit: “Prius auxilium turmae meae ad te superandum mihi opus erat; sed nunc, solus te superare possum.”

source: His words were aimed squarely at Hisoka.
target: Verba eius certe versus Hisoka erant.

source: Collapsing to the ground, Hisoka’s consciousness gradually faded as he caught Lumian’s remark.
target: In terram corruitens, conscientia Hisoka paulatim evanuit dum verba Luminum percipiebat.

source: He instinctively tried to clench his fists, but lacked the strength to do so.
target: Instinctu conatus est pugnos stringere, sed vires id faciendi non habuit.

source: A desperate gasp escaped his throat, his pupils dilating and losing focus.
target: Ex desperatione anhelitus ex gurgite eius evasit, cum pupillae eius dilatarentur et aspectum amitterent.

source: Hisoka cursed himself for choosing Devil Transformation over Wraith Transformation when confronting Lumian Lee.
target: Hisoka se execravit quod Transformationem Diaboli potius quam Transformationem Umbrae elegit, cum Lumian Lee opponebat.

source: If only he had opted for the latter, he could have disrupted Lumian’s attempt to play the blackened bone flute with Wraith Shriek.
target: Si modo alterum elegisset, conatus Lumiani tibiam ossis nigrae cum ululatu umbrae canere intercludere potuisset.

source: Alas, he had no way of knowing the specifics, only able to sense the presence and source of a malicious intent.
target: Heu, nullam viam habebat ad cognoscendum singularia; solum praesentiam ac originem intentionis malevolae sentire poterat.

source: Given Lumian Lee’s ability to infuse bullets, fireballs, and other attacks with electric shocks and target weaknesses with precision, Devil Transformation had seemed the more versatile choice, offering protection against various contingencies.
target: Cum Lumian Lee facultatem habuisset globulos, globos ignis, et alios impetus electricis ictibus infundere atque vulnerabilitates hostium subtile destinare, Transformationem Diaboli optio magis versatilis videbatur, variis casibus tutela praebens.

source: As for why he hadn’t summoned a barrage of Sulfur Fireballs, even at the cost of mutual destruction—Hisoka sensed the considerable distance separating them.
target: Quod attinet ad cur non convocaverit globos ignis sulfuris, etiam ad pretium mutuae interitus, Hisoka sensit longam distantiam inter eos esse.

source: By the time he could conjure and launch ten to twenty fireballs, Lumian Lee would have already finished playing the flute.
target: Cum decem ad viginti globos ignis evocare atque iaculari posset, Lumian Lee iam tibiam canendi perfecerat.

source: With teleportation at his disposal, Lumian could effortlessly evade the clustered assault.
target: Cum teleportatione in promptu esset, Lumian facile impetum congregatum evadere potuit.

source: Moreover, spells like Language of Foulness had a limited range.
target: Praeterea, incantationes, ut “Lingua Foeda”, spatium limitatum habebant.

source: Left with no other recourse, “Hisoka” Twanaku could only resort to Emotional Shock and Desire Detonation, targeting Lumian Lee’s weakness.
target: Nullo alio consilio relicto, “Hisoka” Twanaku solum ad Ictum Emotivum et Detonationem Desiderii confugere potuit, destinans in infirmitatem Lumian Lee.

source: He hoped that after both of them sustained grievous injuries, their recovery rates would be comparable, granting him an opportunity to mount a different response.
target: Sperabat ut, postquam uterque gravi vulnera passi essent, eorum recuperationis gradus comparabiles essent, concedens ei occasionem ad aliud respondendum.

source: B0x𝔫oѵ𝑒𝙡.com
target: B0x𝔫oѵ𝑒𝙡.com

source: However, despite the pain, blood loss, and abnormal look in his eyes, Lumian Lee managed to maintain his balance.
target: Attamen, non obstante dolore, sanguinis detrimento, et aspecto insolito in oculis, Lumian Lee stabilitatem retinere potuit.

source: Fighting through the debilitating effects, he executed a precise area-of-effect bombardment enhanced with electric shocks.
target: Pugnans adversis debilitantibus effectibus, exercuit bombadum areae effectus accuratum, electricis ictibus adiunctum.

source: The effort inflicted fresh wounds upon himself and temporarily paralyzed him.
target: Conatus novas vulnera sibi intulit et eum ad tempus paralysavit.

source: “Gasp…”
target: «Halitus…»

source: Hisoka Twanaku mustered his remaining strength to drag Lumian Lee down with him in a final, desperate gambit of losing control.
target: Hisoka Twanaku virtutem residuam colligens, Lumian Lee secum trahere conatus est in extremo desperato conatu moderationis amittendi.

source: But his life force had reached its limit.
target: Sed vis vitae eius finem attigit.

source: Darkness engulfed his vision as his consciousness slipped into oblivion, a maelstrom of indignation, resentment, and agony consuming him.
target: Tenebrae visionem eius oppresserunt, dum conscientia in oblivionem lapsa erat, turbine indignationis, rancoris et doloris eum consumente.

source: The colossal Devil’s body spasmed a few times before falling still.
target: Corpus ingens Daemoni nonnullis vicibus spasmatum est, deinde quietum cecidit.

source: Hisoka’s last glimmer of hope for revival was extinguished.
target: Ultima spes reviviscendi Hisoka exstincta est.

source: He was well and truly dead.
target: Plene atque vere mortuus erat.

source: As Lumian spoke, he drew his revolver and trained it on the nearby Guardian.
target: Dum Lumian loquebatur, revolverem suum extraxit et in Custodem proximum intentionem dedit.

source: Disoriented and reeling, the Guardian instinctively condensed a broadsword of light.
target: Confusus et attonitus, Custos instinctu gladium latum lucis condidit.

source: Dropping to one knee, he plunged it into the ground before him.
target: Ad genua cecidens, gladium in terram ante se immisit.

source: The sword merged with the earth, erecting an impenetrable invisible wall.
target: Gladius cum terra coniunctus, murum invisibilem et impenetrabilem erexit.

source: As a gravekeeper merged with a dream projection, this Guardian had no effective defense against the Symphony of Hatred.
target: Sicut custos sepulchri cum proiectione somnii se miscuit, hic Custos nullam defensionem efficacem contra Symphoniam Odii habebat.

source: His companions, the Spirit Warlocks and Soul Assurers, caught off guard by the attack, couldn’t pull him into a dream in time to avoid the melody’s direct impact.
target: Socii eius, Spiritus Warlocks et Animarum Assecuratores, capti repentino impetu, eum in somnium trahere non potuerunt ut ictum directum melodiae evitare possent.

source: He could only rely on his own physical and spiritual fortitude to withstand the detonation of desire and emotion.
target: Ipse solum in sua vi corporali et spirituali innitebatur ut eruptionem desiderii et affectus toleraret.

source: For Beyonders with dream projections, this assault posed a mortal threat.
target: Pro Beyonders, quibus proiectiones somniorum praesto sunt, ista oppugnatio minationem mortiferam ferebat.

source: Before the gravekeeper could regain his bearings, another incandescent white fireball wreathed in lightning struck him, triggering a violent explosion.
target: Antequam custos sepulchri sensum suum recuperare potuisset, alius globus ignis albus incandescens, fulmine circumvolutus, eum percussit, violentam explosionem excitans.

source: Fortunately, his boon as a Guardian spared him the fate of his companions, who were culled like stalks of wheat.
target: Fortunate, beneficium eius ut Custos eum servavit a sorte sociis suis, qui quasi caules tritici interscindebantur.

source: Without it, he would have been unable to mount even a token defense on pure instinct.
target: Sine eo, neque defensionem minimam ex solo instinctu exhibere potuisset.

source: Lumian’s green eyes took on an iron-black cast as he stood tall and squeezed the trigger.
target: Oculi virides Luminum in castum ferreum nigros mutaverunt, dum stetit altus et trigerem stringens.

source: Bang! Bang!
target: Bang! Bang!

source: Twin yellow bullets, trailing blazing white flames and silver lightning, slammed into a single point on the invisible wall.
target: Geminae bullae flavae, secum gerentes fulgentes albas flammas et fulgorem argenteum, in unum punctum murum invisibilem percutiebant.

source: Rumble!
target: Tumultus!

source: The already destabilized wall shattered.
target: Murus iam destabilis confractus est.

source: The Guardian could only watch helplessly as a searing white spear enveloped in lightning hurtled towards him, piercing his chest and sending him flying.
target: Custos solum impotens spectare potuit, dum hasta alba, fulmine circumdata, ad eum volitabat, pectus eius pertransfixit et eum iactavit.

source: Another Cull, another bout of digestion.
target: Alia caedes, alia digestio.

source: Clinging to the last shreds of consciousness, the Guardian scattered the broadsword of light into countless minuscule fragments.
target: Ad ultima vestigia conscientiae adhaerens, Custos gladium latum lucis in innumerabilia minima fragmenta dispersit.

source: These luminous shards coalesced into a hurricane that raged in all directions.
target: Haec fulgida fragmenta in turbinem coalescebant, qui in omnibus directionibus saeviebat.

source: Hounded by the storm of light, the blazing white flaming spear soared twenty to thirty meters before finally coming to rest.
target: Persecutus a tempestate lucis, hasta alba flammea ardens viginti ad triginta metra volavit, antequam tandem quiescere coepit.

source: As the flames ebbed away, Lumian straightened his posture, clad in a white shirt, black vest, dark trousers, and a golden straw hat.
target: Cum flammae recederent, Lumian statum rectum sumpsit, indutus tunica alba, lorica nigra, bracas obscuras, et pileum stramentum aureum.

source: Behind him, the bright and terrifying Hurricane of Light gradually petered out, thinning the ground.
target: Post eum, Tempestas Lucis, clara et terribilis, paulatim peteret, terram tenuem faciens.

source: The corpses of the fallen gravekeepers and “Hisoka” Twanaku lay broken and strewn about.
target: Cadavera custodum sepulchri defunctorum et “Hisoka” Twanaku fracta et dispersa iacebant.

source: Reeling from the Symphony of Hatred’s influence, his injuries abnormally severe, Devajo’s gaze flicked from the bodies littering the ground to Lumian, who stood facing him from afar.
target: Perturbatus a Symphoniae Odii influxu et vulneribus insolitè gravibus, Devajo oculos a cadaveribus, quae terram inundabant, ad Luminum convertit, qui a longe ad eum stetit.

source: His already pallid complexion turned even more ashen.
target: Cutis eius, iam pallida, facta est etiam magis cinerosa.

source: What in the world is happening?
target: Quid in mundo accidit?

source: Is he even human?
target: Estne ipse etiam homo?

source: Devajo, in whom thoughts of vengeance had fleetingly stirred following the blow, swiftly abandoned any such notions.
target: Devajo, in quo cogitationes ultionis post ictum breviter excitatae erant, celeriter eas deseruit.

source: Igniting the sulfurous blood he had spat out with azure flames, he hastily retreated into the forest.
target: Ignivens sanguinem sulphureum, quem exspuisset, flammis caeruleis, celeriter in silvas recedebat.

source: He wanted to escape!
target: Volebat effugere!

source: In any case, he could offer no aid to the human skin the archduke had crafted through ritual.
target: Quocumque modo, nullam opem praebere poterat ad cutem humanam, quam archidux per ritum effecit.

source: Lingering in the vicinity of the black ancient tomb would only expose him to greater peril.
target: Morari in vicinitate sepulchri antiqui nigri eum tantum ad maiorem periculum incideret.

source: Lumian paid no heed to Devajo’s flight.
target: Lumian ad evasionem Devajo non curam dedit.

source: Though weakened, his spirituality remained abundant.
target: Quamquam debilitatus, spiritualitas eius adhuc abundabat.

source: Transforming once more into a blazing white flaming spear, he traversed dozens, nearly a hundred meters in a blink, coming to rest beside Lugano, Amandina, and his companions.
target: Iterum se in hastam ignis albi flammarum convertens, per plures, fere centum metra in momento transivit, iuxta Lugano, Amandina, et socios suos quievit.

source: The four Beyonders lay unconscious, spared the Symphony of Hatred’s melody—the effects were minimal, a mere nightmare, but still wracked them with pain.
target: Quattuor Beyonders in inconscientia iacebant, servati a melodia Symphoniae Odii—effectus minimi erant, quasi simplex somnium malum, sed tamen dolore eos vexabant.

source: Their contorted expressions gradually eased as they roused from their comatose state.
target: Eorum vultus contorti paulatim amollirunt, dum ex statu comatoso evigilabantur.

source: Seeing them open their eyes and regain their faculties, Lumian instructed, “Leave this place at once and return to Tizamo. Find somewhere to lay low.”
target: Videns eos oculos aperire et facultates suas recipere, Lumian praecepit: “Relinquite hoc locum statim et revertimini ad Tizamo. Invenite alicubi locum ubi te tegamini.”

source: The conflict unfolding before the black ancient tomb was not something Lugano and the others could influence.
target: Conflictus, qui coram sepulchro antiquo nigro evolvebat, non erat res quam Lugano et ceteri influere poterant.

source: Lumian himself dared not approach, so he intended to send his four temporary allies to safety.
target: Lumian ipse non ausus est appropinquare, itaque consilium cepit quatuor socios temporaneos in securitatem mittere.

source: He had previously consented to Camus and Rhea accompanying him, believing the former’s Psychic Piercing and the latter’s Lightning Arrows could synergize effectively with his own abilities to counter Hisoka’s dream projection, Reaza, and the others.
target: Prius consentiverat ut Camus et Rhea eum comitari, credens “Psychic Piercing” Cami et “Lightning Arrows” Rheae efficaciter cum suis facultatibus convenire posse ad repugnandum proiectionem somnii Hisokae, Reazae, et aliorum.

source: Amandina’s power to compel others into dreams was also quite useful.
target: Potestas Amandinae ut alios in somnia compelleret, etiam valde utilis erat.

source: Moreover, following her was the only way to approach the black ancient tomb without falling prey to the invisible figure’s attacks.
target: Praeterea, eam sequeri sola via erat ad sepulchrum antiqua nigrum accedendum, ne adversus impetus figurae invisibilis incideret.

source: To his surprise, Hisoka had displayed combat prowess far exceeding Padre Cali’s.
target: Ad mirum, Hisoka virtutem pugnandi ostendit, longe superiorem quam illam Padre Cali.

source: With the area unsealed and devoid of preset traps, not only had Camus, Amandina, and the rest failed to render aid, they had ended up hindering each other and becoming a liability.
target: Cum area aperta esset et carens insidiis praeordinatis, Camus, Amandina, et ceteri non solum auxilium praebere non potuerunt, sed etiam invicem se impedientes evaserunt et onus facti sunt.

source: Reflecting on his two prior battles—the attempt to capture Hisoka alive and the confrontation with Padre Cali—Lumian grasped a fundamental principle.
target: Meditatus de duobus prioribus proeliis—conatu Hisoka vivum capiendi et congressu cum Padre Cali—Lumian principium fundamentale intellexit.

source: At times, there was strength in numbers.
target: Interdum in multitudine robur est.

source: But in other situations, solitude was preferable.
target: Sed in aliis condicionibus solitudo praeferenda erat.

source: Facing different foes under varied circumstances demanded adaptability, lest one court disaster by adhering to a fixed approach.
target: Adversus diversos hostes sub variis condicionibus aggredi necessitabat flexibilitatem, ne quis rigidam viam sequendo in calamitatem incidat.

source: Lumian recalled a maxim Emperor Roselle had once shared, as explained by his sister Aurore:
target: Lumian meminit maximam quam Imperator Roselle olim communicaverat, ut a sorore eius Aurore explanatum est:

source: In warfare, as in the flow of water, there are no constant conditions.
target: In bello, sicut in flumine aquae, constantes condiciones non sunt.

source: “We can return to Tizamo? Even me?”
target: “Possumusne ad Tizamo redire? Etiam me?”

source: Lugano couldn’t contain his pleasant surprise.
target: Lugano suam laetam admirationem continere non potuit.

source: Instinctively, he extended his remaining hand, pressing the flickering light against Lumian’s wounds.
target: Instinctu, reliquam manum protendit, lucem micantem super vulnera Luminum pressens.

source: As a Doctor, Lugano was unable to treat a patient’s internal organs directly.
target: Ut medicus, Lugano non poterat directa curare viscera interna aegroti.

source: He needed to open the cavity and make contact with the injured site.
target: Debebat cavitatem aperire et locum vulneratum attingere.

source: It was akin to performing surgery.
target: Hoc erat quasi chirurgiam exercendi simile.

source: Lumian nodded and replied, “Indeed, but you’ll need to remain under Camus and Rhea’s supervision.”
target: Lumian annuens respondit: “Certe, sed necesse erit ut sub custodia Camus et Rhea permaneas.”

source: He planned to linger a while longer, to see if he could aid Iveljsta Eggers, a member of the Church of The Fool’s temperance faction.
target: Consilium cepit paulisper morari, ut videret an auxiliari posset Iveljsta Eggers, membrum Ecclesiae Folli Temperantiae.

source: It was the duty of a Tarot Club’s Minor Arcana card holder.
target: Hoc officium fuit possidenti cartae Minor Arcana in Tarot Club.

source: Of course, Lumian had no intention of venturing into the area immediately fronting the black ancient tomb.
target: Certe, Lumian nullam intensionem habebat in aream statim ante sepulchrum antiqua nigrum ingredi.

source: He might well perish before even realizing what had struck him.
target: Forsitan periret antequam etiam intellexerit quid eum percussisset.

source: His aim was to ascertain whether he could sway Reaza and the others to interact with the corresponding godhood items, or utilize the golden mask upon Hisoka’s corpse to some end.
target: Scopus eius erat investigare num Reaza et ceteros ad res deitatis pertinentes agere moverentur, aut larvam auream super cadaver Hisoka ad aliquod finem uti posset.

source: At that moment, Devajo, who had only just arrived in Tizamo that very night, had already vanished back into the forest, retracing his steps.
target: Illo momento, Devajo, qui modo illa nocte in Tizamo advenisset, iam in silvas recedebat, vestigia sua retrahens.

source: Mustering his dwindling strength, he started sprinting.
target: Virtutem decrescens colligens, celeriter currere coepit.

source: As he ran, Devajo abruptly halted, casting a perplexed gaze towards the path’s bend, obscured by the trees.
target: Dum currebat, Devajo subito sistit et vultum perplexum versus flexum itineris, arboribus tegitum intuebatur.

source: Beneath the dim, crimson moonlight, a short figure approached.
target: Sub obscura et rubra luce lunari, figura brevis accedebat.

source: It was a boy of seven or eight years, garbed in blue pajamas speckled with yellow stars and a matching nightcap.
target: Puer erat annorum septem vel octo, indutus in pyjamas caeruleos, ornatos stellis flavescentibus, et pileum nocturnum assortum.

source: His plump face and the short blond hair peeking out from under the cap were smeared with cream, blood, biscuit crumbs, cake fragments, and sundry other substances.
target: Facies eius rotunda et capilli flavi breves, sub pileo eminentes, erant maculati creta, sanguine, fragmentis crustularum, particulis placentorum, et aliis variis substantiis.

source: His brown eyes blazed with intense hunger and desire.
target: Oculi eius fusci, eximia fame et desiderio ardescens, fulgebant.

source: In his mouth, a vibrant, cold, and slick viper’s tail writhed and shook as he gulped it down, segment by segment.
target: In ore eius, cauda viperae vibrans, frigida et lubricata, se contorquens et tremens, eam guttatim devorabat.

source: The boy’s cheeks bulged as he chomped vigorously.
target: Buccae pueri tumefactae erant, dum vehementer mandebat.

source: In the next instant, he caught sight of Devajo.
target: In momento sequenti, eum Devajo animadvertit.

source: A wave of intense, terrifying malice flooded Devajo’s mind.
target: Unda intensae et terribilis malitiae mentem Devajo replevit.

source: Lugano, having secured permission, was on the verge of informing Camus, Rhea, and Amandina of their impending return to Tizamo when a petrified scream rang out from the forest.
target: Lugano, licentiam obtinens, paene Camus, Rheam, et Amandinam de imminentis reditus ad Tizamo certiorem faceret, cum ex silva strepitus petrificus sonavit.

source: They froze in their tracks.
target: Steterunt immobiles.

source: Mere seconds later, a pitch‑black monstrosity, towering nearly three meters tall with curved goat horns, came barreling out of the forest.
target: Mere paucis secundis post, monstrum piceum ingens, paene tribus metris altum, cum cornibus caprinis curvis, ex silva egressum est.

source: It charged from the direction of Tizamo, making a beeline for the black ancient tomb, panic etched in its every movement.
target: Ex parte Tizamo impetum fecit, viam directam ad sepulchrum antiqua nigrum petens, panico in omni motu insculpta.

source: That man just now? He’s a Devil too… A minion of the Nois family’s Demon, perhaps?
target: Iste vir nunc? Etiam ille Diabolus est… Fortasse minister Daemoni familiae Nois?

source: Could the green‑eyed figure fashioned from human skin be a manifestation of the Nois family’s Demon, projected into the Dream Festival?
target: Num figura viridocula, ex cute humana facta, manifestationem Daemoni familiae Nois esse posset, in Festival Somniorum proiecta?

source: Lumian’s gaze shifted to the shadowed forest at the Devil’s back, an ominous feeling washing over him.
target: Lumian oculos convertit ad silvam umbratam post Diabolum, ubi ominosa sensatio eum invasit.

source: He made a snap decision and addressed Lugano, Amandina, and the others.
target: Subito decrevit et Lugano, Amandina, et reliquis allocutus est.

source: “Grab hold of me!”
target: “Prehendite me!”

source: Lugano swiftly returned to Lumian’s side, seizing his arm.
target: Lugano celeriter ad Luminum rediit, brachium eius arripiens.

source: Camus, Rhea, and Amandina followed suit, startled but mimicking Lugano’s action.
target: Camus, Rhea, et Amandina se contulerunt, perterriti sed actum Lugani imitantes.

source: The five of them winked out of existence, reappearing in close proximity to Hisoka’s corpse.
target: Quinque eorum exsistentia evanuerunt, et mox prope Hisokae cadaver iterum apparuerunt.

source: The instant Amandina’s form finished coalescing, her eyes flew wide.
target: In instante quo forma Amandinae coalescere perfecit, oculi eius late patefacti sunt.

source: Voice quavering, she turned to Lumian and said in a deep voice, “T‑that figure… it’s appeared once more…”
target: Voce quassante, se convertit ad Luminum et voce profunda dixit: “I‑Illa figura… iterum apparuit…”
